admin: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin (id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, name VARCHAR(100), email VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE, password VARCHAR(255), role ENUM('admin','super_admin') DEFAULT 'admin', created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
faculties: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS faculties (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, designation VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, degrees VARCHAR(255), experience VARCHAR(100), image_path VARCHAR(255), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
